name: opencode-copilot-account-switcher
description: GitHub Copilot account switcher plugin for OpenCode
author: jiwangyihao

scripts.wechat:smoke:self-test: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/wechat/compat/openclaw-smoke.js').then(async (m) => { const results = await m.runOpenClawSmoke('self-test'); console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2)); })"
scripts.wechat:smoke:real-account: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/wechat/compat/openclaw-smoke.js').then(async (m) => { const dryRun = process.argv.includes('--dry-run'); const results = await m.runOpenClawSmoke('real-account', { dryRun }); console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2)); })" --
scripts.test:serial:wechat-status-flow:late-a: node --import ./scripts/set-status-flow-phase-late.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern "^broker-entry slash handler: (/reply s3 会路由到 natural-stop reply 分支|natural-stop 回复后再次 /reply s3 返回固定终结原因|两个实例 natural-stop handle 全局唯一且 /reply 唯一命中对应 reply target|旧 binding 残留 active natural-stop 时，新 binding handle 仍全局唯一并命中新 reply target|同一 replyTarget 旧 natural-stop 进入 continued 后，旧 handle 返回固定终结原因，新 active 必须拿新 s\*|旧 terminal s1 保留期内仍返回固定终结原因，新 active natural-stop 必须拿新 s\*|natural-stop 已过期后返回固定已过期提示|旧 handle 已结束后再次 /allow 返回稳定已结束提示|permission rejected 经 terminal 同步后 /allow 仍返回已在电脑端拒绝)$" test/wechat-status-flow.test.js
scripts.test:serial:wechat-status-flow:late-b: node --import ./scripts/set-status-flow-phase-late.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern "^(broker-entry slash handler: recovery 后旧 qid 已结束并提示已被新入口替代|broker-entry slash handler: /recover 即使旧 handle 空闲也会分配 fresh handle 与 fresh route|broker-entry slash handler: /recover 会把恢复作为单一 recoveryMutation 提交|broker-entry slash handler: /recover 入队等待期间 fresh handle/route 被占用时会在队列内重新分配|recover mutation: commit 写入 fresh request 后失败时会清理 fresh route 并写 failed metadata|recover mutation: rollback 失败时仍会尝试写 failed metadata 并暴露 rollback 错误|recover mutation: failed metadata 落盘失败时会暴露错误|broker-entry slash handler: /recover 在 mutation 中途失败时会回滚 fresh request 并持久化 failed 状态|broker-entry slash handler: /recover 会 suppress 旧 routeKey 的 pending notification，后续 drain 不会发送旧 handle|notification dispatcher: recover 并发窗口下旧 pending request 缺失时会 suppress，不发送旧 handle|notification dispatcher: 发送成功后 sent 持久化失败不会在后续 drain 重发|broker-entry runtime lifecycle: 旧通知缺少 scopeKey 时 delivery failure callback 仍会回填 immutable scopeKey)$" test/wechat-status-flow.test.js
scripts.test:serial:wechat-status-flow:late: npm run test:serial:wechat-status-flow:late-a && npm run test:serial:wechat-status-flow:late-b
scripts.test:parallel:shard: node --test test/active-account-quota.test.js test/codex-auth-source.test.js test/codex-invalid-account.test.js test/codex-loader-adapter.test.js test/codex-menu-adapter.test.js test/codex-network-retry.test.js test/codex-plugin-config.test.js test/codex-status-command.test.js test/codex-status-fetcher.test.js test/codex-store.test.js test/codex-sync.test.js test/common-settings-actions.test.js test/common-settings-store.test.js test/copilot-network-retry.test.js test/copilot-sync.test.js test/index-exports.test.js test/loop-safety-plugin.test.js test/menu-runtime.test.js test/menu.test.js test/model-account-map.test.js test/routing-state.test.js test/select.test.js test/session-control-command.test.js test/status-command.test.js test/store.test.js test/ui-menu-wechat.test.js test/wait-tool.test.js test/wechat-bind-flow.test.js test/wechat-dead-letter-store.test.js test/wechat-debug-bundle.test.js test/wechat-jiti-loader.test.js test/wechat-notification-store.test.js test/wechat-openclaw-account-helpers.test.js test/wechat-openclaw-public-helpers.test.js test/wechat-openclaw-qr-gateway.test.js test/wechat-openclaw-smoke.test.js test/wechat-openclaw-sync-buf.test.js test/wechat-openclaw-task3.test.js test/wechat-openclaw-updates-send.test.js test/wechat-operator-store.test.js test/wechat-plugin-hooks-status.test.js test/wechat-qrcode-terminal-loader.test.js test/wechat-request-store.test.js test/wechat-session-digest.test.js test/wechat-state-paths.test.js test/wechat-state-root.test.js test/wechat-token-store-atomic-write.test.js test/wechat-token-store.test.js
